Application Data.NAME: Clean & Fresh Laundry Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Clean & Fresh Laundry Services operates a self-service laundromat offering wash-and-fold laundry services to local residents and businesses. The facility is equipped with modern, energy-efficient machines and adheres to strict safety and environmental regulations. We prioritize customer satisfaction while maintaining a clean and safe environment through regular maintenance and employee training programs. Our operations focus on minimizing the use of harsh chemicals and ensuring efficient water usage. We also have policies in place for routine inspections and audits to ensure compliance with safety standards.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a malfunction in one of the washing machines caused water damage, resulting in a claim filed for $1,500. The claim is currently in progress and is expected to be resolved by 12/01/2023.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: SentrySafe Model 1200, UL Class B, with label indicating 'Residential Security'
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras monitored 24/7, motion sensor lighting around the perimeter, and a regular patrol schedule by hired security personnel during after-hours operations.
